title: Lender provides full purchase price on below market value deal
summary:
District & County Investments has provided £370,000 in bridging finance to fund the full purchase price of a four-bedroom detached property in Luton acquired below market value. The lender assessed the facility against the property's market value rather than the discounted purchase price.

The post Lender provides full purchase price on below market value deal appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Atom bank provides £6.1m for Welsh farm diversification
summary:
Atom bank has provided a £6.12 million commercial loan to a South Wales farm business that has transitioned from dairy farming into hospitality and leisure operations. The enterprise now employs 100 people and operates glamping accommodation, a bistro, play facilities, and an event venue.

The post Atom bank provides £6.1m for Welsh farm diversification appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: £35.5m build-to-rent finance backs Earlsfield scheme
summary:
United Trust Bank has provided £35.5m in build-to-rent finance for a 96-apartment mixed-use development in Earlsfield, south-west London. The facility allows developer Dominus New Homes to refinance its existing development loan as the scheme approaches practical completion.

The post £35.5m build-to-rent finance backs Earlsfield scheme appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: London and South East see widespread price reductions
summary:
Four out of five homes in London and the South East are experiencing price reductions, according to Zoopla's latest House Price Index. More than a third of properties across the UK are now in postcode areas where prices are falling, up from 12% a year ago.

The post London and South East see widespread price reductions appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Mortgage products face withdrawal risk after Budget speech
summary:
Mortgage lenders could withdraw products within hours of the Chancellor's Budget speech on Wednesday, according to warnings from financial industry experts. John Healey is scheduled to deliver his first Budget at lunchtime this Wednesday, with mortgage advisers cautioning that market reactions could trigger rapid changes to lending products and rates.

The post Mortgage products face withdrawal risk after Budget speech appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Rightmove updates website descriptions after rival’s challenge
summary:
Rightmove has updated website descriptions that claimed to feature over 900,000 properties for sale and over 200,000 to rent, following a challenge from rival platform MyPorta. The wording, which dated back to 2010, was removed in September 2026 after scrutiny over its accuracy.

The post Rightmove updates website descriptions after rival’s challenge appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Conveyancers call for stamp duty reform as confidence falls
summary:
Industry confidence in the UK property market has fallen to its lowest level on record, with 27% of conveyancers identifying stamp duty reform as their top Budget priority. The Council for Licensed Conveyancers reports professional confidence in market stability has dropped to 26%, the lowest since tracking began.

The post Conveyancers call for stamp duty reform as confidence falls appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Autumn budgets impact on London luxury property analysed
summary:
A decade-long analysis of Autumn Budgets reveals that political and economic certainty drives prime London property sales, with the Johnson-Sunak administration producing the strongest market performance whilst current Labour policies face headwinds. Research by Beauchamp Estates examined sales of properties above £5 million and £10 million across Prime Central London during four-month periods before and after Autumn Budgets from 2015 to 2025.

The post Autumn budgets impact on London luxury property analysed appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Blackbear acquires Neath agency to reach seven branches
summary:
Welsh estate agency Blackbear has acquired Welvan Estate Agents in Neath, expanding its network to seven branches less than two and a half years after launching in Pembrokeshire. The acquisition coincides with Welvan's 25th anniversary in the local residential sales and lettings market.

The post Blackbear acquires Neath agency to reach seven branches appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Developer secures £7.1m exit finance for Bristol scheme
summary:
Mortimer Street Capital has arranged £7.1 million in development exit finance with Recognise Bank for a residential scheme south of Bristol. The facility covers seven completed homes and two plots under construction, enabling the developer to release capital for new acquisitions.
